svg.title: Visualizing relative entropy between two Bernoulli distributions
svg.desc: The left panel compares the true Bernoulli distribution p, whose probability of one is 0.9, with the model q, whose probability of one is 0.5. The right panel shows that KL divergence is zero when q equals p and grows as q moves away.

g.text: Mismatch grows as the model moves away from the truth.
